title: Follow the Wall
story: The path snakes about. Use the sensors to choose: forward if clear, otherwise turn.
goal: Reach the flag on every map.
hints: When the front is blocked, look right, then left.
socratic: What should the parrot do at each step?
What does the parrot need to look at before it moves?
Compare your result with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: how does your code decide what to do next?
